verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API whose reference pages are available as raw Markdown, with an llms.txt index. However, the docs explicitly note that no OpenAPI spec is documented, and probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. Markdown reference pages are an adjacent convenience, not a downloadable machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
